title: RAG Orchestrator Kit: multi-language tool-calling samples and docs walkthrough
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Add RAG Orchestrator Kit: multi-language quickstarts (TS/Go/Python), new tool-adapter pattern, updates to docs site quickstart and troubleshooting. No breaking changes.
description: Context: teams frequently ask for a repeatable pattern for RAG that combines on-demand retrieval, tool calling, and safe fallbacks across hosted and private deployments. This PR introduces the 'RAG Orchestrator Kit' — a set of quickstarts and sample agents demonstrating: 1) a TypeScript agent with tool-calling adapters (web search, SQL read, calculator) and streaming responses; 2) a compact Go sample that shows low-latency embedding lookups and a lightweight tool shim; 3) an updated Python reference that wires the kit into Redwood SDK tracing hooks. Motivation: make it trivial for engineers to evaluate RAG end-to-end and to adopt a single orchestrator pattern across languages. Changes in this PR: scaffold templates (templates/rag-orchestrator/*); full TS example with step-by-step README and Dockerfile (examples/ts-orchestrator/*); Go example with minimal deps and embed index building (examples/go-orchestrator/*); docs site how-to page and troubleshooting section (docs/quickstarts/rag-orchestrator.md); utility tool-adapter library that standardizes tool signatures (lib/tool-adapters/README.md); e2e test harness for CI (ci/e2e/rag-orchestrator.yml). Checklist: [x] TypeScript quickstart and README; [x] Go quickstart; [x] Python wiring example; [x] docs site page and snippets; [x] unit + smoke tests in CI; [x] basic security review for tool adapters. Usage notes: the TS quickstart includes a local dev script that boots a minimal vector-store (sqlite+annoy) and mounts Redis for caching; env examples and sample prompts are in examples/ts-orchestrator/. Migration guidance: this is additive — existing examples remain unchanged. If teams adopt the tool-adapter, they should run the provided static analysis script to ensure there are no unhandled tool exceptions. Testing and validation: CI runs lint, unit tests, and an optional e2e job that spins up the mini infra; manual review included live demo with product engineering. Links: related Linear tasks ENG-1423 and PM-678; internal RFC ref: rfc/rag-orchestrator.md.
